conflict_resolution_rule: Same field, same timestamp, different values: numeric fields keep the lower value (conservative rate); string fields keep the lexicographically smaller value. Applied to: evt_011 vs evt_012 (Diego rate_usd_hr at 2026-06-02T08:30:00Z -> 36 wins over 38).
default_stage_rule: Contacts with no explicit stage event default to 'new'. Applied to: c_anika, c_lena, c_tomas (had no stage update before being contacted), and c_bob, c_jamie, c_diego (stage set via contact.updated).
